claims.value: The prior architecture was a proposed Update 1-only distributed backbone-and-spurs network with protected core hubs, modular production cells, single-item rail lines and buffers, replacing the superseded monolithic mega-base assumption.

The delta now requires one 500-heat Constructorizer and two 650-heat Facturers while every Base Core stays level 0 at 1,000 capacity. Required-machine heat totals 1,800, but capacity is enforced per core: Constructorizer + Facturer = 1,150, two Facturers = 1,300, and all three = 1,800, so every possible heavy-machine co-location exceeds one level-0 core.

The safe minimum layout is three occupied level-0 cores: one Constructorizer cell at 500/1,000 required-machine heat and two separate Facturer cells at 650/1,000 each. Their respective remaining budgets are 500, 350 and 350 heat for all generators, extractors, processors, storage and other powered support assigned to that core; construction is unsafe unless measured existing load plus the complete support plan stays at or below 1,000 independently at every core.

Before building, verify the live Update 1 build menu and measure each candidate core's existing load, then produce a per-core ledger including the heavy machine and every supporting powered building. Use only confirmed Update 1 equipment; exclude hidden or future content and do not rely on disputed amplifier capacity. Begin construction only when each ledger is independently no more than 1,000 heat.
